ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels exceeding 95% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to distal tips and sparse internal speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a solid low-intensity dark field. Discrete high-intensity geometric clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Sparse mid-tone mottling and small circular light-pixel clusters are detected in the central and lower-left quadrants of the visible fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; approximate 45-degree interior angle with significant vertical depth relative to the fluke baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the medial sections, transitioning to higher-frequency serrations and jagged pixel-edge variations at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer tips; leading edge exhibits a continuous convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) located on the distal tips of both lobes. Several smaller, isolated high-contrast circular spots are visible on the interior ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the outer margins of both fluke lobes; presence of small circular depigmented spots on the central fluke surface likely representing parasitic or attachment scars.
other_distinctive_markers: Water turbulence and spray (high-intensity white pixels) partially occluding the lower-central region where the fluke meets the peduncle.
